question.text: Which fee structure is PROHIBITED in PMS?

answer.text: Performance fee with high water mark (HWM)
Fixed management fee disclosed in the PMS agreement

explanation.text: The Logic: PMS regulations do not permit upfront performance fees. Performance-linked fees are allowed only on crystallised gains under HWM or hurdle-rate structures. The Trap: HWM and hurdle-rate based performance fees and disclosed fixed management fees are permitted; the upfront performance fee is what is prohibited. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.156, p.158, p.160-161.
